description_en: Grants Elastic Network Interface (ENI) permissions to an Alibaba Cloud partner (certified ISV) or an individual user
description_zh: 调用CreateNetworkInterfacePermission为阿里云合作伙伴（认证ISV）或者个人用户授权弹性网卡权限
kebab_example: aliyun ecs create-network-interface-permission --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --account-id 1234567890 --network-interface-id eni-bp14v2sdd3v8htln0000 --permission InstanceAttach --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateNetworkInterfacePermission

parameters.description_en: The ID of the network interface controller (NIC).
parameters.help_en: The ID of the network interface controller (NIC)

parameters.description_en:
The network interface controller (NIC) permission action. Only InstanceAttach is supported.

InstanceAttach: allows the authorized user to attach your NIC to their ECS instance. The ECS instance must be in the same zone as the NIC.
parameters.description_zh:
弹性网卡权限动作。当前仅支持InstanceAttach。

InstanceAttach：允许授权的用户将您的弹性网卡挂载到对方的ECS实例上。ECS实例必须和弹性网卡在同一个可用区中。
